title: KNEC Official Security Advisory & Fraud Awareness
description: Official warnings regarding fake results revision sites, social media scammers, and unauthorized agents.

faqs.question: Can KNEC change or upgrade examination results after publication?
faqs.answer: No. KNEC does NOT change exam results for individuals upon request or payment. Any person or channel offering 'grade upgrades' is fraudulent.

faqs.question: Which are the only official KNEC portals?
faqs.answer: Official services are strictly offered through knec.ac.ke, qmis.knec.ac.ke, cba.knec.ac.ke, and official institutional portals.
